identity_vocabulary.why: One flag used to carry five different meanings. L32 resolved cleanly, matched its own recorded title, and was still a cell-biology thesis standing in for a Simplex reference, because nothing compared the work against the reason it was selected. These are now separate fields.
identity_vocabulary.identifier_resolved: resolved | unresolved | not_machine_resolvable - does the identifier name any work
identity_vocabulary.intended_work_matched: verified | unverified | corrected | matches_intended_work | unresolved - was the resolved work checked against why_selected by a person. `matches_intended_work` means the registered title and venue decide it; `unresolved` means they do not and the text was not read. Neither marks the work read or any claim supported.
identity_vocabulary.claim_supported: never recorded here; a register entry supports no claim. Findings live in docs/day3-reading-records.json
